attempts.why_died: Candidate 2 incorrect: width-k Res(lin) is degree-(2k+1) PC over F2, and random 3-CNF needs PC degree Omega(n) over every field (Alekhnovich-Razborov 2001), so it answers SAT there
Candidate 1 incorrect: Tseitin on expanders and random 3-CNF need resolution width Omega(n) (Ben-Sasson-Wigderson 2001), so width-k saturation answers SAT there
Candidate 3 is exponential if two 2026 preprints hold: dag-like Res(+) needs exp size on bit PHP (arXiv:2609.23015) and on random 3-CNF (arXiv:2610.00837). Unreviewed; reopen if refuted.
Candidate 4: SP with quasipoly coefficients is simulated by CP (CCC 2021), and CP is exponential on clique-coloring (Pudlak 1997) and random log-width CNF (FPPR 2017)
